title: Welcome to HaxePress
excerpt: Create and manage content for any kind of website.
content:
## Your content workspace

HaxePress brings content, pages, media, themes and plugins together. Use the administration area to create a draft, add an image and publish when you are ready.

## Start with a draft

Every content item has its own title, URL, excerpt and body. Save your work privately before publishing it.

## Make the site yours

Choose a theme, organize your navigation and configure your site settings.
image_alt: Sample image for welcome to hxwell cms

title: Create and organize content
excerpt: Use categories, tags and clear URLs to organize your content.
content:
## Organize your content

Categories group related content. Tags connect items through more specific subjects. Both can be managed from the administration area.

## Keep URLs clear

Choose a short URL that describes the content. You can update it later from the editor.
image_alt: Sample image for create and organize content

title: Build useful pages
excerpt: Create permanent pages for information your visitors need.
content:
## Pages for your site

Use pages for contact information, services, documentation or any other content that should have a permanent address.

## Add pages to navigation

The navigation manager can link directly to a published page. The link follows changes to its URL.
image_alt: Sample image for build useful pages

title: Manage your media library
excerpt: Upload and reuse images across content and pages.
content:
## A shared media library

Upload images from the editor or media library. Add a description so the image can be understood by more visitors.

## Reuse existing uploads

Choose an existing image when you need it again. Images already used by content are protected from accidental removal.
image_alt: Sample image for manage your media library

title: Customize the site appearance
excerpt: Preview and configure themes without changing your content.
content:
## Choose a theme

Themes control how your public site presents its content. Preview a theme with desktop, tablet and mobile views before activating it.

## Keep content separate

Your content stays in the database when the active theme changes.
image_alt: Sample image for customize the site appearance

title: Extend your CMS with plugins
excerpt: Install plugins that add routes, features and their own data models.
content:
## Add the features you need

Plugins can add forms, feeds, admin pages and integrations. Install a package from the administration area, review its settings and activate it.

## Native extension APIs

Plugin authors can use HxWell models, query builder, Schema, Cache and Storage. Each plugin can track its own schema migrations and scoped data.
image_alt: Sample image for extend your cms with plugins

title: Work with your team
excerpt: Give each team member access appropriate to their work.
content:
## Work together

Owners manage the site and extensions. Editors manage and publish content. Writers can prepare their own drafts.

## Review changes

Content revisions and the activity log help your team keep track of its work.
image_alt: Sample image for work with your team
